features.name: Unlimited win multiplier
features.description: In free spins the multiplier rises by 1 after every reaction.

review:
The game that launched Megaways, and playing it now you can see why the format took over. The grid changes on every spin, so no two spins look the same.

In free spins, the multiplier goes up with every cascade and never resets – that's where the 10,000x max comes from. High volatility, 96% RTP. The graphics look dated next to modern games, but it still plays really well. A true classic.
